newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land to raise 4.0 bln peso debt.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land to raise 4.0 bln peso debt.

text.p: Philippine real estate giant Ayala Land Inc is set to generate up to 4.0 billion pesos by offering five-year convertible commercial papers, documents released by the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday said.
Ayala said the debt paper will be offered at face value and bear a fixed interest rate of 6.0 percent per annum payable every quarter.
The debt issue can be converted into class B shares based on the average price of Ayala Land B shares in the past ten days plus a premium of 10 to 12 percent.
Proceeds of the offering will be used to finance its land banking and develoment activities.
The offering period will start on March 10 and end on March 18.
BPI Capital Corp and AB Capital and Investment Corp are the joint issue managers. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
